rules.statement: The doctrine of lis pendens is applicable to movable property under the Roman-Dutch law.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Roman-Dutch law text books, however, draw no distinction between movable and immovable property, and there is express authority that the principle applies equally to movable property ( Voet XLIV. 6, 1: Nathan's Common Law of South Africa, Vol 4, s. 2173 )."
